firstPlayerRule: There is no permanent first player. After the simultaneous opening steps of a round, resolve the remaining steps starting with the car furthest ahead in the race and continuing in race position order.
clarifications: During setup, place cars randomly in starting-grid positions. Each round begins with simultaneous gear selection and card play before cars resolve their movement.
interpretation: Random starting-grid placement determines the opening race positions; it does not create a lasting player-turn order.
